description: 충청북도_도로관리청별 도로 현황 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 충청북도. 이 데이터는 충청북도에서 제공하는 도로관리청별 도로 현황 자료로, 2025년 12월 31일 기준 도로 등급별, 행정구역별 총 연장과 포장 여부, 미개통·미개설 현황 등을 집계한 것입니다. Coverage: 충청북도. The portal files it under the publisher 충청북도. Its tags are 포장도, 미포장도, 도로길이, 개통도로, 미개통도로. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-08-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
